descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · S04 Existing specs: the provider row and the kind of failure decide the path — Haiku default, row-picked primary, temporary / refused / unclassified / deployment, sticky fallback (S25 merged here)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T1 A Haiku failure that is not temporary skips the Haiku retry and goes straight to Mistral (TFA-94422 AC 3)
  • U5 When the primary model (Haiku) is forced to fail or time out, Haiku is retried once, then the same call goes to Mistral (UAT OAT-03 step 6; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 3; TFA-94422 AC 2)
  • T4 The default model is Haiku, set in the 'AI provider' table and changeable without a new release (TFA-94422 AC 1; UAT 3.1)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given chat() with bedrock.invoke stubbed: Haiku fails with ThrottlingException 429 (temporary), ValidationException 400 (refused), a plain unclassified Error, or AccessDeniedException 403 (deployment); providers.spec.ts defaults and chat() with row variants

When Ask once per row; resolve the default; run with the row's model = Mistral (no fallback, and with a Haiku fallback); run two calls in one operation after a fallback; start a new invocation

Then Temporary: Haiku once more, then Mistral. Refused: Mistral at once, no second Haiku try. Unclassified: Mistral at once. Deployment: thrown at once, no retry and no fallback. Row: default text generation is Bedrock Claude Haiku 4.5; the row's model is the primary; inside one operation the fallback is kept for later calls; …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright api assertions on call order. Rows 1–3 are TFA-94422 AC 2 / AC 3. Row 4 (thrown, no Mistral) is the AC 3 exception from self-review item C: recorded, not judged until Q5 is answered. 'Changeable without a new release' is shown by the row tests, not by changing a deployed row (aiProvider:_set is forbidden here); …

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S04 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane A).
